title: Senior Statistical Programmer I
description:
Posted date Oct. 19, 2026

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-262114

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262114 **Date posted** 10/19/2026

**Title: Senior Statistical Programmer I**

* Career Level – D

* Location: Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore

* Work Type: Hybrid

**About AstraZeneca:**

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused pharmaceutical company that focuses on the research, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines. We aim to transform the lives of patients with improved outcomes and a better quality of life. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work.

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn world-class programming into decisions that bring medicines to patients faster? As a Senior Statistical Programmer I, you will lead study and project-level programming that underpins clinical evidence, regulatory submissions and safety insights, translating complex protocols into reliable, inspection-ready outputs.

You will own delivery for clinical studies, orchestrating SAS, R and Python code and using AI-enabled solutions to scale quality and speed. Your judgement will set standards, your mentorship will lift others, and your work will influence protocol design, analysis choices and how results are communicated. Do you see yourself shaping best of industry practices in a dynamic environment while delivering tangible results for clinicians, regulators and patients?

We thrive in an environment where unknowns are common and change is constant. You will combine rigor with curiosity, navigating a rules-focused setting while finding inventive routes to get the right work done, at pace & with purpose.

**Accountabilities:**

* Study and Project Delivery Leadership: Lead programming deliveries for clinical studies and small to medium, complex projects, meeting scope, timelines and quality commitments.
* Protocol and Program Implementation: Implement statistical programming aspects of protocols and clinical development programs so analyses answer the right questions and meet regulatory expectations.
* Quality Ownership: Build high quality into your own outputs and into the work of others through reviews, robust testing and continuous feedback.
* Efficient, Independent Programming: Program independently with high efficiency and quality across datasets, analyses and reporting.
* Specifications and Documentation: Write clear specifications and ensure completeness of relevant documentation for traceability and inspection readiness.
* Standards and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to or drive best of the industry practices that improve quality, efficiency and effectiveness within the function.
* Standards and Automation: Ensure compliance with standards and improve automation usage, including AI-enabled approaches where appropriate.
* Planning and Team Leadership: Plan and lead team activities and tasks, aligning resources, removing blockers and forecasting needs.
* Risk Management: Identify, manage and communicate risks across assigned studies and projects, enabling timely decisions and course correction.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work proactively with statisticians, lead programmers, data managers and study leaders to align on priorities and deliverables.
* Vendor Partnership: Work cooperatively with contract programming providers, setting expectations, reviewing outputs and ensuring timely delivery.
* Stakeholder Influence: Provide subject matter expertise on programming-related items to influence & shape outcomes.
* Technical Initiatives: Participate in or lead technical initiatives that raise capability across tools, standards & automation.
* Project Management: Apply project management practices to plan, track and deliver programming aspects of drug or technical projects.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Bachelors in Mathematics (i.e., Applied Math, Engineering, etc), Statistics, Computer Science, Life Science or equivalent
* Minimum of 6 years experience in clinical statistical programming.
* Excellent SAS programming skills including macro language
* Demonstrated experience in R programming
* Experience in Python programming
* Ability with AI-enabled solutions, such as developing or working with AI agents
* Proficient knowledge of the clinical development process
* Thorough knowledge of industry standards
* Ability to apply programming knowledge to problem solving
* Ability to manage relevant documentation
* Ability to influence on Programming related items

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Ability to proactively manage concurrent activities within a study or part of project

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Here, your code becomes evidence that changes lives. You will collaborate with diverse experts who challenge and support each other, bringing different perspectives into the same room to spark bold thinking and better solutions. With access to modern tooling, AI-assisted workflows and enterprise-scale data, you will deepen your craft while influencing decisions across multiple therapy areas. We value kindness alongside ambition, and we recognize outcomes, learn from setbacks and give you the freedom to improve processes that matter—so your impact is both immediate and enduring for patients worldwide.

**Call to Action:**

Bring your SAS, R, Python and AI skills to a team where your programming shapes pivotal evidence—step in and help accelerate life-changing medicines today!When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

====================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Bank of America is embarking on a multi-year core banking transformation journey to replace its legacy core banking platform with modern technology platforms. As part of the core banking platform transformation, the bank will seek opportunities to revamp & improve its end to end ecosystem to improve operational & technological efficiency. The core banking platforms support multiple functions in Global Banking and Markets business: e.g. payments, deposits, credit, trade finance, foreign exchange, general ledger.**


The Junior Java Full Stack Developer will be an individual contributor responsible for developing, enhancing, testing and supporting web applications. The role requires hands-on development across backend and frontend technologies and close collaboration with technical leads, business analysts, QA, infrastructure, DevOps and support teams located onshore and offshore.

  

Responsibilities

* Understand end-to-end application architecture, interfaces, configurations and business requirements.
* Participate in the Software Development Life Cycle covering requirement analysis, design, development, testing, implementation and support using Agile and Scrum practices.
* Design, develop and enhance backend components using Java, J2EE, Spring Framework and Spring Boot.
* Develop REST APIs and integrate applications with internal services, databases and external interfaces.
* Develop responsive frontend components using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3.
* Develop and maintain Microsoft SQL Server database objects, including tables, views, stored procedures and functions.
* Write clean, modular and maintainable code in line with coding, security and engineering standards.
* Create unit test cases and participate in component, integration, regression and performance testing.
* Participate in daily Scrum meetings, sprint planning, grooming, reviews and demonstrations.
* Coordinate with SIT and UAT teams for test execution and resolve defects on priority.
* Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to support builds, deployments and releases across non-production and production environments.
* Perform code reviews, debugging, defect analysis, performance tuning and root-cause analysis.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation procedures and support documentation.
* Provide application support during testing, release and post-production stabilization activities.

  

Requirements:

* Education: BE/B Tech/MCA
* Certifications If Any - NA
* Experience Range: 2- 5 years

Foundational Skills

* 2 to 5 years of software development experience in analysis, design, development, testing and deployment of web-based and distributed applications.
* Hands-on experience in Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate and REST APIs.
* Hands-on frontend development experience using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, joins, indexes, stored procedures and query optimization.
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming, MVC architecture, design patterns, exception handling and logging.
* Experience in developing unit test cases using JUnit and Mockito or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience using Maven or Gradle, Git, pull requests and code-review practices.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and familiarity with DevOps practices.
* Working knowledge of application servers such as JBoss, WebLogic or WebSphere.
* Knowledge of secure web-service implementation, including OAuth and JSON Web Tokens.
* Experience debugging and modifying existing enterprise applications in addition to developing new functionality.
* Good written and verbal communication, analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with guidance from senior engineers while managing assigned deliverables and timelines.

  

Desired Skills:

* Experience with microservices, Spring Security, Spring Cloud and API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes or cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of messaging and integration technologies such as Kafka, MQ, Mule, SOAP, WSDL or service-oriented architecture.
* Exposure to scheduling tools such as AutoSys and BladeLogic.
* Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk or SiteScope.
* Experience in banking or financial-services applications, preferably payments, deposits, credit, trade finance or foreign exchange.

**Job Description**
-------------------

About the Role

  
  

CogNet HR Solutions is seeking an AI Developer to design and build our AI-powered intelligent document processing and workflow automation platform which will process complex business documents such as PDFs, scanned documents, spreadsheets, forms, invoices, payroll reports, insurance documents, loss runs, applications, contracts, and other structured and unstructured data.

The AI Developer will work across the complete AI pipeline from document ingestion and classification through extraction, validation, reasoning, workflow automation, human review, and enterprise integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take AI solutions from prototype to secure, reliable production.

Preferred Technology Stack

AI / LLM: OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Hugging Face, vision-language models.

AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, and agent/tool-calling frameworks.

Programming: Strong Python proficiency; FastAPI, Pydantic, REST APIs, JSON and JSON Schema. Experience integrating AI services with C# / ASP.NET Core is highly desirable.

Document Processing: PyMuPDF/PDF libraries, OCR technologies, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, Document AI, OpenCV, and Excel processing.

Data: SQL Server/PostgreSQL, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, Redis or equivalent caching.

Cloud / DevOps: AWS, Docker, Git, CI/CD, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch, SQS or equivalent messaging/queue technologies.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

### **Requirements**

Key Responsibilities

  
  

AI & LLM Development

* Design and develop AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Build AI agents for document classification, extraction, validation, reasoning, and workflow execution.

* Develop structured extraction pipelines that convert unstructured documents into validated JSON and database records.

* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent workflows.

* Evaluate models based on accuracy, latency, security, and cost.

* Build confidence scoring and human-review routing for exceptions.

* Implement guardrails and validation to minimize hallucinations and incorrect extraction.

Intelligent Document Processing

Build document-processing pipelines supporting: PDF / Images / Excel / Word / Email Classification OCR/Vision AI Extraction Validation Business Rules Human Review API/Database.

* Document type detection and classification.

* OCR and vision-based document understanding.

* Table, form, key-value, and entity extraction.

* Multi-page processing, document splitting, and routing.

* Cross-document comparison and reconciliation.

* Confidence scoring, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop review.

* Structured JSON output generation.

Agentic Workflow Development

* Develop agents that identify document types and select appropriate extraction schemas.

* Extract and validate information against business rules.

* Compare multiple documents and identify missing or inconsistent information.

* Call APIs and enterprise systems and route documents to appropriate workflows.

* Generate summaries and recommendations and escalate exceptions for human review.

* Design reliable orchestration with retries, logging, fallbacks, and error handling.

Application & API Development

* Develop backend AI services and REST APIs.

* Integrate AI services with CogNet applications and third-party enterprise platforms.

* Build asynchronous/background processing for large document workloads.

* Design scalable queues and batch-processing capabilities.

* Implement secure API authentication and authorization.

Cloud & Production AI

* Deploy and operate AI applications on AWS.

* Build containerized applications using Docker.

* Implement scalable AI inference and document-processing architectures.

* Monitor model performance, latency, token consumption, failures, and cost.

* Implement production logging, monitoring, retries, and exception handling.

RAG & Enterprise Search

* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and hybrid search.

* Chunking strategies, metadata filtering, document retrieval, and citation/source grounding.

* Enterprise document search or knowledge-management experience is an advantage.

AI Quality & Evaluation

* Create AI evaluation datasets and measure extraction accuracy.

* Compare model performance and track false positives/false negatives.

* Test prompts and extraction schemas and implement AI regression testing.

* Monitor production AI quality and optimize model selection for accuracy, speed, and cost.

Security & Data Privacy

* Encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access control, and secure API design.

* Secrets management, audit logging, data isolation, and PII handling.

* Secure LLM integration and protection against prompt injection and malicious documents.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or related discipline.

* 5+ years of software development experience.

* Strong Python programming skills and practical experience building applications using LLM APIs.

* Experience developing REST APIs and backend services.

* Experience processing PDFs and other business documents.

* Strong understanding of structured and unstructured data and SQL databases.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) and AI agents/agentic workflows.

* Insurance or Workers’ Compensation documents, payroll/HR data, or financial documents.

* Invoice processing, document reconciliation, and enterprise workflow automation.

* RAG applications, AWS Bedrock, AWS Textract, OpenAI APIs, or high-volume document-processing systems.

What You Will Build

Document Upload Automatic Classification AI Extraction Validation Human Review Workflow Enterprise Integration

* Insurance submission processing and Workers’ Compensation loss-run analysis.

* Payroll and HR document extraction.

* Benefits reconciliation, invoice processing, and bank reconciliation.

* Contract/form extraction, document comparison, and AI-powered enterprise document search.

What Success Looks Like

* Build production-ready document AI pipelines supporting multiple document types and configurable schemas.

* Achieve measurable extraction accuracy and establish automated evaluation and monitoring.

* Develop reusable AI agents and services and integrate Drive with CogNet applications.

* Implement human-in-the-loop exception workflows.

* Improve document-processing speed and automation rates while reducing inference cost.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a builder rather than someone focused only on AI research. The ideal candidate can take a business problem such as: “Read these 200-page insurance documents, identify the document types, extract the required information, validate the information, identify exceptions, and return structured data through an API,” and design and implement the complete production solution.

The candidate should be comfortable experimenting with new AI models while maintaining the engineering discipline required for secure, reliable enterprise software.

description:
**Advanced Associate, Cloud Service Engineer**

**Location:** Chennai, India (Hybrid)

**Team:** Atlassian Administration & Engineering

**Experience:** 2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM).

We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Platform administration:** Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration.
* **User lifecycle automation:** Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning.
* **Space and project lifecycle:** Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale.
* **Reduce legacy customizations:** Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible.
* **Automation engineering:** Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation.
* **Engineering practices:** Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc.
* **AI-assisted engineering:** Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar.
* **Service metrics and observability:** Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing.
* **Solution evaluation:** Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit.
* **Continuous improvement:** Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives.
* **Best practices and governance:** Help define standards, naming conventions, and configuration guidelines for each product, and document them.
* **Instance consolidation:** Contribute to ongoing migration and consolidation work, including planning, data validation, and post-migration cleanup.
* **Escalations and mentoring:** Resolve complex platform issues, and share knowledge with less experienced teammates and stakeholders.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required:**

* 2+ years of hands-on administration of Jira and/or Confluence, preferably in Atlassian Cloud
* Working experience with Atlassian Automation, including building and troubleshooting rules
* Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or a similar language, and experience building automation against REST APIs (including JSON, authentication, pagination, and rate limits)
* Hands-on experience with Git and version-controlled code or configuration, plus a working understanding of CI/CD practices: build, test, release, versioning, and branching strategies
* Daily, effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude, with the judgment to validate, refine, or reject what they produce
* A solid understanding of Jira configuration: schemes, workflows, screens, fields, and permissions
* Experience managing users and groups at scale in Atlassian Admin
* The ability to analyze an existing configuration, recommend simplifications, and explain the trade-offs clearly
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with stakeholders around the world
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Nice to have:**

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-620, or Cloud Organization Admin)
* Experience with AWS services (such as Timestream, Lambda, or S3) and with dashboards in Grafana or similar tools
* Experience administering JSM (request types, queues, SLAs, portals) or JPD
* Experience with identity integration such as Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, SAML SSO, or SCIM
* Migration experience with JCMA/CCMA or instance merges
* Experience with ScriptRunner or other marketplace apps, and with assessing app usage

**What You’ll Gain**

* Ownership of meaningful parts of a large, enterprise-scale Atlassian Cloud platform
* Real influence over how a global platform is standardized and modernized
* A clear growth path to Specialist and Advanced Specialist roles on the Atlassian Platform Engineering team
* Support for Atlassian certifications and ongoing learning

title: Staff Enterprise App Admin - Ironclad CLM and Workflow Developer
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer  
  
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide.  
  
Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.  
  
We are seeking a Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer to join our Business Technology team. This role leads the design, implementation, and administration of Ironclad as Five9's contract lifecycle management platform and serves as the technical lead for replacing DocuSign CLM with Ironclad. You will architect the target-state solution, build and maintain the Workflow Designer workflows, templates, and clause libraries used to generate, route, negotiate, and execute Five9's customer agreements, and guide the migration of existing templates, workflows, and executed agreements from DocuSign CLM.  
  
The ideal candidate is a senior business systems professional with seven or more years of experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years configuring Ironclad in production. The candidate holds the Ironclad Core Administration Certification and, ideally, has completed Ironclad's Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation), with prior experience leading a CLM migration or platform replacement strongly preferred.  
  
The position is a hybrid role combining in-office and work-from-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Lead the solution design and implementation of Ironclad CLM, defining the target-state architecture for contract intake, generation, review, negotiation, approval, signature, repository, and reporting, and serving as the subject matter expert for Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance.
* Own the replacement of DocuSign CLM with Ironclad, including migration strategy and roadmap, template and workflow inventory and rationalization, repository and metadata migration of executed agreements, parallel run, cutover, in-flight agreement handling, and decommissioning of legacy DocuSign CLM components.
* Design, build, and maintain Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, signature routing, and exception handling.
* Create and maintain commercial document templates and clause libraries — including Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, and renewals — using legal language and clauses approved by the Legal team, with conditional content based on product, pricing, transaction type, and geography.
* Administer and configure the Ironclad platform, including users, groups, roles and permissions, SSO and provisioning, repository structure, metadata and record types, and environment and release management.
* Design and maintain the integrations between Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, including Workflow Sync and Record Sync, field mappings, and generation of service orders from CPQ quotes and quote lines, ensuring contract status and executed agreements are accurately returned to Salesforce.
* Define the electronic signature approach for the future state, including Ironclad Signature and any external eSignature provider retained during or after the transition, and manage the related configuration and signature coordination.
* Use the Ironclad API and webhooks to build custom integrations, automations, and data migration tooling with other Five9 systems as required.
* Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT to translate business and legal requirements into scalable solutions, and lead change management, documentation, user training, and adoption.
* Troubleshoot workflow, document generation, data mapping, integration, and signature issues, and drive them to resolution.
* Establish administration standards, governance, and best practices, and mentor team members and partner consultants on Ironclad configuration and design.
* Identify opportunities to simplify contract processes, reduce manual effort, and accelerate contract execution, and track outcomes through Ironclad reporting and analytics.

Key Requirements  
  
Required Qualifications:

* Seven or more years of business systems experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years of hands-on Ironclad configuration in production.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ironclad Core Administration Certification required. Completion of the Ironclad Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation) strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading a CLM implementation or migration, ideally replacing DocuSign CLM or a comparable platform, including template and workflow rationalization, repository and metadata migration, and cutover planning.
* Advanced hands-on experience designing and building Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, and exception handling.
* Experience building and maintaining commercial document templates (e.g., Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, renewals) and clause libraries using legal language approved by the Legal team.
* Experience designing and supporting Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ integrations with a CLM platform, including generating documents from quotes and quote lines and syncing contract data and status back to Salesforce (Account, Opportunity, Quote, Quote Line, Product, Contract).
* Experience with the Ironclad API, webhooks, and integration patterns, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, basic JavaScript, and SQL.
* Working knowledge of electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign eSignature and Ironclad Signature, covering templates, recipients, signing order, and authentication.
* Basic Salesforce administrator-level knowledge (objects, fields, relationships, and permission sets) and familiarity with the Salesforce CPQ data model and document generation process.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word template formatting, including tables, styles, sections, headers, and conditional content.
* Strong solution design, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to lead initiatives independently, influence stakeholders across Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT, and work across a distributed, global team.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Salesforce Certified Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification is a plus.
* Prior experience with DocuSign CLM and DocuSign eSignature administration, which helps with migration scoping, is a plus.
* Experience with project delivery methodologies, enterprise change management, and mentoring or leading consultants is a plus.

Why You'll Love This Role:

* You will lead the move to Ironclad and play a central role in shaping how Five9 generates, negotiates, and executes customer contracts at scale.
* You will partner closely with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance, gaining broad visibility into the commercial contracting process.
* You will work at the intersection of Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, solving practical, cross-system problems that directly impact deal velocity.
* If you enjoy simplifying complex processes, setting technical direction, and building reliable, well-documented systems, this role offers a strong opportunity to grow as a CLM architect.

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.  
Workplace location: This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Building Automation, ELV/ICT
description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.
* Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge and Personal Attributes:

* Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies.
* Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes.
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations.
* Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems.
* Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems.
* Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally.

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you.

Senior PHP Developer — Job Description

CodeIgniter 4, PHP 8 and application modernisation

Position Details

Field Details

Experience 4–7 years

Openings 1

About ColorPodge

ColorPodge develops cloud-based colour-management software for the apparel and homewares industries. Its

SaaS products support colour development, approvals, supply-chain collaboration, and specialised business

processes for international customers.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced PHP developer to join a product team that is modernising an established,

business-critical web application on CodeIgniter 4, PHP 8 and MySQL. The work is upgrading existing modules

to the current framework and language versions while the application stays in use, with existing features, data

and user workflows preserved exactly.

The role owns modules end to end: understanding the existing code and its database usage, re-implementing it

on CodeIgniter 4 following the team's established structure, verifying that behaviour is unchanged, and getting

the work tested and merged. This is not a greenfield role. It suits a developer who reads and understands

existing code carefully, converts it faithfully, and improves it where that can be done safely.

Key Responsibilities

Code Analysis and Conversion

Verification and Testing

Engineering Practice

Read and understand existing CodeIgniter controllers, libraries, models, views and helpers, and document

the business rules and role-based behaviour they implement.

Re-implement modules on CodeIgniter 4 using the team's patterns: explicit routes, base controllers,

models, services for business logic, filters for authentication and security, and language files.

Preserve existing URLs, form actions, AJAX endpoints and API contracts so that links and integrations keep

working after the upgrade.

Refactor large controllers and models into maintainable units without changing business outcomes.

Upgrade legacy PHP code to PHP 8: replace deprecated and removed functions, fix type and null handling,

and apply modern PHP where it improves clarity.

Migrate database access to CodeIgniter 4 models and query builder, and handle MySQL version

differences such as SQL modes, strict types, dates and collations.

Compare each upgraded page and workflow with the existing version, role by role, and confirm the same

controls, data, validations, calculations, database writes and emails.

Raise defects found in the existing code separately rather than silently reproducing or silently fixing them.

Write and maintain PHPUnit tests for services and models, and Playwright end-to-end tests for pages, and

keep the regression suite passing.

Work with the QA team on test cases, defect reports and retesting for each module before it is merged.

Write database migrations and seeders with working rollback where schema or data changes are needed.

Keep email, file upload and third-party integrations working through the application's service layer and the

safety rules for non-production environments.

Follow the Git workflow: feature branches, small reviewable commits, pull requests, code review and

merge; resolve merge conflicts in shared files carefully.

Deploy and verify changes on containerised staging environments and investigate issues using application

and server logs.

Improve the user interface progressively while upgrading: modernise legacy jQuery code, improve forms,

tables and dialogs, and add responsiveness and accessibility, without removing features or changing

navigation.

Collaboration and Reporting

Required Skills and Qualifications

Apply secure coding practices (input validation, output escaping, CSRF protection, role-based

authorisation) and fix weaknesses found in existing code.

Work to a module-by-module plan with the team lead, report progress against milestones, and flag early

when a module is slipping or blocked.

Take part in requirement clarification with the technical lead and business stakeholders when existing

behaviour is ambiguous.

Document the modules upgraded: structure, decisions taken, agreed changes in behaviour, and anything

the support team needs to know.

Use company-approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly, within the review and testing process,

and never as a substitute for understanding the code.

4–7 years of professional PHP development, including at least 2 years of hands-on work on production

applications built with CodeIgniter, and demonstrable experience with CodeIgniter 4 (routing, controllers,

models, services, filters, validation, migrations).

Direct experience maintaining or upgrading legacy PHP applications: reading unfamiliar code, mapping its

behaviour, and refactoring without breaking it. Experience with a CodeIgniter 3 to 4 or PHP major-version

upgrade is a strong advantage.

Strong PHP 8 knowledge: type declarations, null handling, exceptions, namespaces, Composer and PSR

standards.

Strong MySQL skills: schema design, joins, indexes, query optimisation, transactions, and version

differences.

Solid front-end skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery, including AJAX-driven pages, and willingness to

modernise legacy front-end code.

Experience writing automated tests (PHPUnit; Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and working with a

regression suite.

Proficiency with Git in a branch, pull-request and code-review workflow, including conflict resolution.

Working knowledge of Linux, a web server such as Nginx or Apache, PHP-FPM and Docker, and the ability

to read application and server logs.

Understanding of web application security: authentication, session handling, role-based authorisation,

CSRF, XSS, SQL injection, and secure file handling.

Disciplined, careful working style: small verifiable changes, evidence before claiming a module is complete,

and clear written communication.

Preferred Skills

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Relevant certifications are a plus.

ISMS / ISO/IEC 27001 Responsibilities

Practice good cyber hygiene by following the established policies and procedures:

Experience with role-based business applications in supply chain, retail, manufacturing or approval

workflows.

Experience with cloud storage, transactional email services and single sign-on integrations.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

and AI-assisted tools.

Encrypt anything that stores sensitive information.

Turn on built-in anti-malware software and firewall.

Back up important files and data.

**Job title:** Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** Manager, IT Systems Administration**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time**Schedule:** Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests

 **Purpose of the Role**
Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.  

While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus. **Your Key Responsibilities:****Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends

**Cloud Security**

* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments

**Cloud Networking**

* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures

**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**

* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed

**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**

* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments

**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**

* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records

 **What You’ll Need:****Minimum:*** 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.

 **Your Advantage:*** Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment

description:
**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.


**Job Description**


This role is for GIS Penetration testing team to conduct penetration tests and source code reviews of our internal/external web, mobile, web, and web API service applications, leveraging both manual techniques as well as automated tools to uncover and report security vulnerabilities that exist.
  

  

You must be knowledgeable with business risks associated to common security vulnerabilities and to be able to effectively communicate complex technical concepts such as security vulnerabilities to application developers and/or senior managers who may have little to no experience with application security.
  

  

You must have the ability to work independently in a very large scale, enterprise setting and collaborate with peer team members. Previous experience as an application security professional with a large Financial Institution a plus.


**Responsibilities**


* Performs assigned analysis of internal and external threats on information systems and predict future threat behavior
* Incorporates threat actors' tactics, techniques, and procedures into offensive security testing
* Performs assessments of the security, effectiveness, and practicality of multiple technology systems
* Leverages innovative thinking to help solve problems or introduce new ideas to processes or products applicable to offensive security
* Prepares and presents detailed technical information for various media including documents, reports, and notifications
* Provides clear and practical advice regarding managed risks
* Learns and develops advanced technical and leadership skills; Mentor Junior assessors in technical tradecraft and soft skill

**Requirements**


**Education:** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech


**Certifications, If Any:** GWAPT, CEH, OSCP, SANS, CEH


**Experience Range:** 6\+ years


**Foundational Skills:**


* Strong hands\-on experience in conducting comprehensive manual penetration tests and source code reviews against web, API, mobile applications, services, platforms, systems, and networks to identify security vulnerabilities.
* Solid experience in using various security tools such as Invicti, SoapUI, Burp Suite Pro, Checkmarx, Kali Linux, Metasploit, etc.
* Very Good Communication \& Interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of network and Web related protocols/technologies.
* Experience with latest penetration testing techniques (e.g., web application proxies, packet capture analysis software, browser extensions, advanced penetration testing tools (full stack), Linux distributions, Windows OS, etc.).
* Experience of penetration testing on mobile platforms such as iOS, Android, and mobile device simulators.
* Solid programming/debugging skills with proficiency in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript, HTML, XML, PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, JSON, Python, Perl, Shell script, Objective\-C, and SOAP/REST web APIs.
* Expert\-level experience and knowledge in the following areas:


	+ Authentication and security protocols.
	+ Application session management.
	+ Applied cryptography.
	+ Common communication protocols.
	+ Mobile frameworks.
	+ Single sign\-on technologies.
	+ Development frameworks (Angular, React, etc.).
	+ Exploit automation platforms.
* Knowledge of a Structured Query Language.
* Developer experience or coding background (nice\-to\-have).

**Desired Skills:**


* Experience of penetration testing and source code reviews on web, API and mobile platforms.
* Solid programming/debugging skills with proficiency in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript, HTML, XML, PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, JSON, Objective\-C, and SOAP/REST web APIs.

**Work Timings:** 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM


**Job Location:** Mumbai, Chennai

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As Alexa Audio, we own the audio experiences on Alexa enabled devices. These experiences include Music, Podcast, Audio Books, Radio, and Ambient soundscapes. Our integration skill kits enable seamless integration of 1P / 3P audio content providers (e.g., Amazon Music, Spotify, Apple etc.) with Alexa devices. Audio is one of the most widely used experiences on Alexa, and is enjoyed by millions of customers on a daily basis.  

  

There is a universe of tens of millions of distinct audio content that is available across streaming services. Using your voice, and timely proactive suggestions are the easiest ways to get to what you want. Alexa makes this magical for customers: ask any Alexa\-enabled device to play your favorite song, podcast, book or a radio station, and Alexa will find the right content for you and play it. We also support being able to control and manage playback across multiple devices, and movement of media playback across them. It is still Day 1 for the audio experiences, and we're looking for a leader to help us make it even better.  

  

On the Alexa Entertainment Team, you will have an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience, design, architecture, and implementation of state of the art products that will be used every day by people you know. No matter what the role, we’re looking for people who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, demonstrate a high degree of product ownership, and want to have fun while they make history.  

  

In this role you’ll have independent technical ownership on new customer features and supporting architecture on a day to day and week to week basis. You’ll learn new in\-demand skills like building voice control interfaces and scalable API platforms interfacing with Generative AI that will be highly valuable as you grow your career at Amazon and beyond. You’ll work directly with Product Management and Design to refine the customer experience for Alexa entertainment featured products. You’ll join a unique team in the Alexa organization with our own culture – we move fast to deliver new great features for customers and have a ton of fun doing it.  

  

Come join us as we build the Voice OS for Entertainment in the home using innovative technologies. We’re breaking new ground and need your help to bring our vision to reality.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

A person in this role is expected to :\-  

1\. Design, implement, and deliver software in ambiguous and complex problem spaces of Alexa Audio working with partners such as product managers, technical program managers, and senior/principal engineers to deliver on the business goals related to Audio Experience.  

  

2\. Create infrastructure to bring the power of LLMs into the Audio space while championing best practices for software engineering and operational excellence.  

  

3\. Create tools and software to evaluate, analyze, and improve the model accuracy for various Audio experiences, while reducing latency and customer friction.  

  

4\. Influence the operational and engineering excellence roadmap across core audio services set by the lead SDEs to proactively address peak readiness, hardware efficiency, scaling, throttling and improve availability \& resiliency for Alexa Audio Services.  

  

5\. Provide valuable design feedback around latency considerations, two\-way door decisions and valuable coding feedback around coding standards, quality, versioning to both internal and external away teams, guide them on best practices for developing within Audio owned services and push back on proposals which do not adhere to our high quality standards.  

  

6\. Mentor junior members of the team and help them onboard. They participate in interviews and hiring efforts for the team, and constantly share knowledge of components they own and have expert knowledge of through mediums such as demos, lunch\-n\-learns, and org\-wide emails.  

  

7\. Leadership principles that are most important for this role are ownership, deliver results, deep dive, bias for action, hire \& develop the best, and earns trust.  

  

A day in the life  

We collaborate across disciplines. You will have the opportunity to work closely with product managers, UX designers and researchers, and business intelligence engineers to innovate, measure, analyze and refine the experiences we deliver to millions of customers across the planet on a daily basis. Our roles are all well defined, but we encourage individuals to cross boundaries and learn from each other.
  

  

About the team  

As Alexa Audio, we own the audio experiences on Alexa enabled devices. These experiences include Music, Podcast, Audio Books, Radio, and Ambient soundscapes. Our integration skill kits enable seamless integration of 1P / 3P audio content providers (e.g., Amazon Music, Spotify, Apple etc.) with Alexa devices. Audio is one of the most widely used experiences on Alexa, and is enjoyed by millions of customers on a daily basis.  

  

There is a universe of tens of millions of distinct audio content that is available across streaming services. Using your voice, and timely proactive suggestions are the easiest ways to get to what you want. Alexa makes this magical for customers: ask any Alexa\-enabled device to play your favorite song, podcast, book or a station, and Alexa will find the right content for you and play it. We also support being able to control and manage playback across multiple devices, and movement of media playback across them. It is still Day 1 for the audio experiences, and we're looking for a leader to help us make it even better.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows\-based edge devices, cloud\-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide.



This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands\-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies.

* Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria.


* Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices.



Incident \& Operational Support


* Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments.


* Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions.


**Collaboration \& Growth**


* Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads.


* Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills.


* Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team.


* Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes.

* Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field


* Proficiency in C\# and the .NET platform


* Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages


* Strong understanding of Test\-Driven Development (TDD)

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high\-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.


The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.


The ideal candidate is a hands\-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud\-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data\-intensive solutions for regulated or asset\-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long\-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest\-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map\-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer\-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high\-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome\-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service\-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer\-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI\-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6\-12 Months**


The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer\-facing teams to confirm the highest\-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.


Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest\-value Unify Energy capabilities.
